item.title: After two years and over 6,000 hours, Monitors Unboxed's long-term OLED gaming monitor test shows increasing burn-in
item.content:encoded: How problematic it is, well, that's up to you...

item.title: 'I think the fact that everything is scarce is fantastic for us' says Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang '...in a world of constraint, you have no choice but to choose the best'
item.content:encoded: At least someone is positive about it.

item.title: Nvidia's next hardware launch for us gamers could be an RTX 5050 with a whopping 1 GB of extra VRAM
item.content:encoded: And I'm smiling behind a single tear drop.

item.title: Obsbot Tiny 3 review
item.content:encoded: High quality webcam with a high price premium.

item.title: Obsbot Tiny 3 Lite review
item.content:encoded: A smarter buy for a high-end webcam.

item.title: After whiffing its release date by 5 years, Crimson Desert is putting out oodles of preview stuff as 'We never want to be accused of hiding anything, because we have a lot of ground to make up'
item.content:encoded: It's been a long road.

item.title: One of the largest hacker forums in the world has been seized by the US DoJ
item.content:encoded: We don't yet know how many arrests have been carried out.

item.title: 'The reason why we're so beloved in the videogame industry and we're so deep in it still is, in a lot of ways, we created the modern videogame industry' says Nvidia CEO Huang
item.content:encoded: Strap in, folks, and save your opinions until the end.

item.title: 'Without Intel, I don’t know if Windows would have happened… without Mac, I wonder whether Office would have happened' says Microsoft CEO
item.content:encoded: An attitude of gratitude.

item.title: Intel bigs up its latest 18A chip node as fit for external customers but probably not Nvidia, for now
item.content:encoded: Intel CPUs living with Nvidia GPUs.

item.title: You can blame some of Deus Ex: Invisible War's console limitations on the publisher's 'weird theories that FPS games don't sell or RPGs don't sell'
item.content:encoded: Two theories that have definitely stood the test of time. No one plays RPGs anymore.

item.title: I've spent two days with Elgato's new Wave Link free audio mixing software and it's a genuine benefit for streaming, recording or gaming
item.content:encoded: Though it does make the big new Stream Deck less desirable.

item.title: How to get a Broken Guidance System in Arc Raiders
item.content:encoded: Locate this industrial item to prep your Expedition.

item.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse isn't a roguelike, says Konami, despite it being made by the 2 studios behind Dead Cells
item.content:encoded: Back to basics.

item.title: After Resident Evil Requiem, Leon Kennedy's actor wants to see Code Veronica remade: 'I think that would be one hell of a game'
item.content:encoded: It'll happen sooner or later, surely.

item.title: After playing a bunch of Midnight, I don't think I miss WoW's combat addons or my old class design at all
item.content:encoded: Then again, I'm one of the lucky ones.

item.title: Hallelujah, Bungie's confirmed that Marathon's battle passes don't expire, you can purchase old ones, and you never pay for power
item.content:encoded: Now make it happen in Destiny.

item.title: Final Fantasy 11, a 23-year-old MMO, is getting so many new players it's having to stop character creation on its busiest server
item.content:encoded: FF11 is still going strong.

item.title: How to open the Rookery Cache in WoW Midnight
item.content:encoded: Get the Sunwing Hatchling pet and one more tally towards the Treasures of Eversong achievement.

item.title: Third time's hopefully the charm as Nvidia releases hotfix driver to tackle voltage issues and Resident Evil Requiem performance in one fel swoop
item.content:encoded: An official fix, so no roll-backs needed.

item.title: Out-of-bounds camera reveals Resident Evil Requiem's Grace is a Redditor
item.content:encoded: Horrifyingly, she uses light mode.

item.title: Copyright trolling kept evidence of Japanese cult classic Cookie's Bustle offline, until now
item.content:encoded: The evil is defeated.

item.title: How many of these MMORPGs can you name in just 6 minutes based on a handful of vague details?
item.content:encoded: A challenge for the eternally online.

item.title: Highguard gets a new playable character, skill trees and more ahead of next week's closure
item.content:encoded: Wildlight's skeleton crew is pumping out material while it still can.

item.title: Hunt: Showdown keeps experimenting with the extraction genre, and its next twist sounds irresistible: Soon, extraction points and loot won't appear on the map
item.content:encoded: The Devil's Trail begins March 18.

item.title: US government reportedly debating whether to force Tencent to give up its US-based game holdings
item.content:encoded: The process began during the first Trump administration, and is apparently now picking up steam.

item.title: More than 800 gamers took an exam to prove they could complete an '80s adventure game without peeking at a walkthrough—and only 2 passed
item.content:encoded: Only .25% of players completed the AGAT, the Adventure Game Aptitude Test, designed by fiendish developer Woe Industries.

item.title: Stop the clock: Resident Evil Requiem's first sexy Leon mod hit Nexus Mods just 4 days, 11 hours, and 23 minutes after launch
item.content:encoded: I'm glad we can all share this moment.

item.title: MindsEye studio claims it now has 'overwhelming evidence of organized espionage and corporate sabotage' that somehow made its game bad, and also it's laying off more people
item.content:encoded: This would all be kind of amusing if it wasn't for the facts that more game developers are losing their jobs.

item.title: Resident Evil Requiem's 5 million sales have made it one of Capcom's all-time top 20 bestsellers in just 4 days
item.content:encoded: Call it the Leon bump. (Or don't call it that).

item.title: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive is back: 3 years after it was muscled out by Counter-Strike 2, CS:GO has its own Steam page again and has powered its way back onto Steam's most-played chart
item.content:encoded: CS:GO was subsumed into Counter-Strike 2 a few years ago, but now it has its own Steam page again.

item.title: Deus Ex: Invisible War wasn't what it should have been because the studio moved to an engine that was really built for Thief: 'A super-boneheaded call, very bad decision… it really tanked development'
item.content:encoded: "I wish we could redo that project and just stitch the maps together."

item.title: A 9,999,999 gold painting in World of Warcraft: Midnight sent secret finders on a hunt for the ultimate discount and one thrifty player finally figured it out
item.content:encoded: Players will do anything for housing decor.

item.title: Finally someone has threaded the needle between survival game and horse girl sim
item.content:encoded: The Legend of Khiimori is a surprisingly detailed horse courier sim that I'm actually loving more than just in solidarity with my horse girl gamer friends.

item.title: Ubisoft finally confirms the Assassin's Creed 4: Black Flag remake is real, and it's dropping the '4' for some reason
item.content:encoded: "Keep your spyglass on the horizon."

item.title: The devs on Deus Ex: Invisible War knew its most-hated part was a 'terrible idea,' and they give the director 'sh*t about it all the time'
item.content:encoded: Some choices need a reload.

item.title: Qualcomm's new Snapdragon X2 Arm CPU pops up in Geekbench and wallops the x86 laptop competition by over 30% in single-core performance
item.content:encoded: How much this translates into gaming is very much another question.

item.title: Highguard director shares stats and thoughts on the game's failure, denies conspiracy theories about where it all went wrong: 'Nobody will know the true story of the studio or game'
item.content:encoded: Highguard did better than it might appear, but still nowhere near well enough to be sustainable.

item.title: As Assassin's Creed Shadows support comes to an end, Ubisoft reiterates what's coming in the future, and yes, co-op factors into it somehow
item.content:encoded: Also, everything you've heard about the PvP project is a lie.

item.title: As hardware prices make heads spin, Apple of all companies has just announced a new MacBook laptop for only $599
item.content:encoded: I don't think you're ready for the takedown.

item.title: Meta's new FrameSync feature aims to make VR a little less nauseating
item.content:encoded: As performance demands grow for Quest headsets, Meta's updating its frame timing technique.

item.title: Indie dev says 'best I can do is sentient tofu' after fans demand a male protagonist—they respond oh yeah, actually Mr Tofu works fine, thanks
item.content:encoded: Everyone got what they wanted. Kind of.

item.title: South Korean authorities seized $5.6 million worth of crypto then accidentally posted pictures of the super-secret recovery phrase, resulting in the loss of... $4.8 million worth of crypto
item.content:encoded: Aaaand it's gone. Mostly.

item.title: Overwatch's grand revamp event is a suffocating blip in an otherwise successful return to form
item.content:encoded: Conquest should be fun, but it's more frustrating.

item.title: AMD's CPU division is booming as CEO Dr. Lisa Su says sales 'far exceeded my expectations'
item.content:encoded: And yes, of course, it's down to AI.

item.title: Arc Raiders devs had to nerf the blueprint drop rate because players are too good at finding them: 'First Wave caches have been handing out a lot of blueprints'
item.content:encoded: Wish that was me smh.

item.title: After planning 2 more paid acts, narrative scifi power-washer Ambrosia Sky is instead finishing its story in one free update to 'maximize' its focus on what players loved: 'People got in on that sapphic yearning right away'
item.content:encoded: So much for slow burn.

item.title: Kiss goodbye to Ghost of Yotei on PC: Sony is U-turning on its 'let's put our games on PC' strategy and bunkering back down with console exclusives, says Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: Nothing gold can stay.

item.title: Marathon roadmap: All upcoming updates
item.content:encoded: New Runners, weapons, gear, and maps.

item.title: Control Resonant is far more of an RPG than I expected, complete with talent trees, stats screens, and build-crafting that wouldn't feel out of place in a Diablo game
item.content:encoded: Remedy's taking another ambitious creative swing with its new sequel.
